guarantees.claim: When reset (rst_ni low), timer_value is cleared to zero.
When timer_update is asserted, timer_value is loaded with timer_limit.
When timer_expired is asserted, timer_value is cleared to zero (despite comment stating 'keep the value').
When timer_enable, timer_pulse, and |timer_value (non-zero) are all true, timer_value decrements by 1.
When none of the explicit update conditions (reset, update, expired, countdown) are active, timer_value retains its previous value.

assumptions.claim: timer_pulse must be a single-cycle pulse per intended timer tick when timer_enable is asserted.
assumptions.cond: timer_enable is high and not in reset
assumptions.risk: If timer_pulse is active for multiple cycles, timer_value may decrement multiple times in one tick, causing premature expiration.

uncertain_points.claim: The comment on timer_expired assignment says 'keep the value' but the actual RTL assigns zero. The intended behavior on expiration is ambiguous.
uncertain_points.risk: If the intent was to preserve the value, the timer erroneously resets, potentially disrupting health-test timing or causing false clears.

uncertain_points.claim: A timer_limit of zero, when loaded via timer_update, makes timer_value zero, and the guard |timer_value prevents any subsequent decrements. This configuration leaves the timer permanently stalled with no expiration path.
uncertain_points.risk: The timer never expires, which could block downstream health checks or timeouts that depend on timer_expired.
